rejected_rule.statement: A party asserting prescriptive title must establish uninterrupted, undisturbed, and adverse possession to sustain a claim of prescription.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In the absence of such proof, the burden must be held not to have been discharged. As stated earlier in this Judgment, it is clear that the Defendant-Respondents have failed to discharge the burden of proof to establish prescriptive rights described above, particularly, regarding the establishment of uninterrupted, undisturbed, adverse possession in respect of which a declaration is sought.
